summary: Full regression pass for NER-SLIDE. Executed 4 ML regression tests + 14 API integration tests (all pass) plus 11 Playwright frontend flows (all pass). Model loaded once, 22 zones seeded, run-all fully green, Open-Meteo reachable, multilingual alert translation (6 langs) working via Emergent Universal LLM Key. Road-blockage report side-effect verified. Frontend routes render map, stat cards, priority list, alerts, zones list (22), zone detail simulate slider, alerts language switch, field UI, and public page. No blockers found.

minor.issue: sklearn version mismatch warning: joblib pickled with sklearn 1.8.0, runtime 1.9.0. Predictions match exactly (regression test asserts <1e-6 drift), but consider re-pickling to silence InconsistentVersionWarning.

integration_issues.flow: Zone detail simulate rainfall 2.5x on NER-001
integration_issues.issue: Severity remained HIGH (not upgraded further). This is expected behaviour when the zone is already HIGH under nominal rainfall; the multiplier only pushes to CRITICAL if the baseline rainfall × 2.5 crosses the higher threshold. Backend override test (with explicit high rainfall_override) correctly upgrades to CRITICAL, so the endpoint & model are fine. Consider (a) preselecting a currently-LOW/MEDIUM zone in the demo script, or (b) increasing max slider value to 4x so the demo visibly upgrades severity every time.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Re-pickle v5_final_model.joblib with current sklearn to silence InconsistentVersionWarning (numerical output already matches exactly).
OPTIONAL/UX: Demo-tuning — increase simulate-rain slider max from 3x to 4x, or make the default demo zone start at LOW/MEDIUM so 2.5x visibly upgrades severity.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 595 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold. Consider splitting into app/api/{predictions,alerts,zones,gis,reports}.py routers to improve maintainability.
All MongoDB `_id` fields are stripped via `_strip()` helper — good.
ML model correctly loaded once at process startup (ml_service singleton) — confirmed by request timing (<1s per predict).
All environment variables (REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, MONGO_URL, EMERGENT_LLM_KEY) sourced from .env — no hardcoded URLs found.
All interactive frontend elements carry data-testid — excellent testability.
Multilingual alert path has a rule-based fallback in llm_service which prevents 500s on LLM rate-limit — correct defensive design.
test_credentials: Role-based login only (no password). Roles: AUTHORITY, FIELD_OFFICER, CITIZEN, ADMIN (see /app/memory/test_credentials.md).
seed_data_creation: None created. Used existing 22 seeded zones. Test artifacts prefixed with TEST_ where applicable (report description, alert reason).
